signatures.description: Implement a delta-state CRDT replication layer in Go: each replica keeps an OR-Map plus a version-vector causal context, emits minimal delta batches on local mutation, and merges out-of-order or duplicated deltas idempotently. The hard part is context pruning: compact the causal context by collecting tombstones only below the safe frontier while proving that no future delta can be resurrected, and keep per-key state sizes bounded under a 10k-op concurrent adversarial schedule. Include a deterministic convergence harness that checks all replicas reach identical state regardless of message delivery order and partition/heal permutations.
